audit.local_solver_evidence: Library ConvergenceInfo and independently evaluated normalized eigenpair residuals; prior records without these fields remain unaudited locally.
audit.checkpoint_interpretation: In-progress variational state; perform full transfer and entropy checks before scientific use.

variational_bound_interpretation: An above-trial raw expectation supports candidate exclusion only after state normalization/canonical consistency is checked, and a fixed-density comparison also needs a compatible trial filling. Satisfying the bound does not certify convergence.
correlation_length_units: Cell size is recorded in cell_slices; physical axial lengths use nearest-neighbor honeycomb distance one
fixed_point_detection_scope: Detected multiplicity is a lower bound from two independent starts, not a complete peripheral-spectrum certificate.
